item.title: STL RESULT Today, December 17, 2025 Visayas, Mindanao
item.description: STL RESULT TODAY – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announces the STL December 17, 2025 (Wednesday) in Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao at 10:30AM, 3PM, 7PM and 8PM draws. The localized draws are held daily from Monday to Sunday. PCSO is also conducting draws for five jackpot-bearing games such as Ultra Lotto 6/58, Grand Lotto 6/55, Super Lotto 6/49, Mega Lotto 6/45 and Lotto 6/42.

item.title: LOTTO RESULT December 17, 2025 6/55, 6/45, 4D, Swertres, EZ2
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announces the official lotto result for Wednesday, December 17, 2025. Monitor here the winning numbers for 6/45, 6/55, EZ2 (2D Lotto), Swertres (3D lotto), and 4D Lotto. PCSO said jackpot prize for the evening major draws – Mega Lotto 6/45 and Grand Lotto 6/55 – now hitting Php 8.9 million and Php 222 million, respectively.
